Assemble a temperature L1 object from a climate folder

Source: R/io.R
dm_build_temp_l1.Rd

Recursively searches clim_root for xlsx/csv files with a recognisable timestamp and temperature column and assembles a 'treenetproc' temperature L1 object. Requires the suggested package 'treenetproc'. build_temp_L1_generic() is the original DendroMatic name, kept as an exported alias.

Usage

build_temp_L1_generic(
  clim_root,
  site_tag,
  tz = "UTC",
  reso = 10L,
  ts_col_priority = c("timestamp_UTC", "ts", "timestamp", "date_time", "datetime",
    "DateTime", "TIMESTAMP"),
  temp_col_priority = c("Temp_degC_forest", "Ta_degC", "temp", "temperature",
    "Temp_degC", "Tair", "TA"),
  out_rds = NULL
)

dm_build_temp_l1(
  clim_root,
  site_tag,
  tz = "UTC",
  reso = 10L,
  ts_col_priority = c("timestamp_UTC", "ts", "timestamp", "date_time", "datetime",
    "DateTime", "TIMESTAMP"),
  temp_col_priority = c("Temp_degC_forest", "Ta_degC", "temp", "temperature",
    "Temp_degC", "Tair", "TA"),
  out_rds = NULL
)

Arguments

clim_root

Root directory searched for climate files.

site_tag

Site code used for the series name.

tz

Timezone of the input timestamps.

reso

Output resolution in minutes.

ts_col_priority, temp_col_priority

Candidate column names tried in order for the timestamp and temperature columns.

out_rds

Optional path; when given, the result is also saved there.

Value

A temperature L1 data.frame, or NULL when no usable file is found.
